chapter.verse: Tua ciangin Jerusalem panin Pharisee-te leh laisiamte Jesu' kiangah hong pai uh a,
“Bang hangin na nungzuite in khanglui zatngeiziate palsat uh ahi hiam? Amaute in an a nek ciangun khut sil lo uh hi,” ci uh hi.
Jesu in hih bangin dawng hi: “Tua ahihleh bang hangin nomau' zatngeizia huhau-in Pasian' thupiakna palsat na hi uh hiam?
‘Na pa leh na nu zahtak in,’ ci-in leh, ‘A pa ahi-a a nu ahi zongin a gensia peuhpeuh thahna thuak hen,’ ci-in Pasian in thu hong pia hilo hiam?
Ahi zongin note in, ‘Mi khatpeuh in a pa' kiangah ahihkeileh a nu' kiangah, "Kei' tungpan na ngah ding khatpeuh Pasian' tunga biakpiak van ahi hi," a cih nakleh
a pa a zahtak ding kisam nawnlo hi,’ na ci uh hi. Tua hi a, nomau' zatngeizia thu huhau-in Pasian' thu bangmahlo na suaksak uh hi.
No a puatham kineihte aw, Isaiah in note' thu hih bangin maantak na genkhol hi:
‘Hih mite in muklekam tawh kei hong zahtak uh a, a lungsim uh ahihleh kei tawh kigamla hi;
mite' thupiakna teng upna thu bangin hilhcian uh a, khiatna nei lo pi-in kei hong bia uh hi.’”
Tua ciangin Jesu in mite ama' kiangah samin tua mite' kiangah, “Za unla theitel un:
Mihing a ninsak pen kam sunga a tumsukte hilo-in kam sungpana a pusuakte hizaw hi. Tua in mihing ninsak hi,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin nungzuite hong pai-in Jesu' kiangah, “Hih thugenna a za Pharisee-te lungnuammawh ahihlam na thei hiam?” ci uh hi.
Jesu in, “Vantunga ka Pa' suan ahilo kung khempeuh kibotkhia ding hi.
Tua mite hici koih lel un. Amau pen khuamulo lamlakte hi uh a, khuamulo khat in khuamulo dang khat makaih leh a nihun dum sung kia ding uh hi,” ci hi.
Ahi zongin Peter in Jesu' kiangah, “Tua thugenteh kote hong gentel in,” ci hi.
Jesu in hih bangin dawng hi: “Note zong thu a tel nailo pi na hi uh hiam?
Kam sunga tumsuk peuhpeuh gilpi sung tawnin tua pan awngbuk ah kithakhiakik cih theilo na hi uh hiam?
Ahih hangin kam pana hong pusuak pen lungsim pan hong piangkhia hi a, tua in mihing ninsak hi.
A hang pen ngaihsut hoihlote, tualthahna, angkawmna, nulepa tatkhialhna, guktakna, zuau teci panna, daisakna cihte lungsim panin hong paikhia hi.
Hihte pen mi khat a ninsak thei thute hi a, ahi zongin khut sil lo-a annekna in kuamah ninsak lo hi.”
Tua lai pan Jesu paikhia-in Tyre leh Sidon gam ah kihemkhia hi.
En un, tua gam panin Canaan numei khat hong paikhia a, “David' Tapa, Topa aw, kei hong khual in. Ka tanu dawilut, nasia mahmah hi,” ci-in kiko hi.
Ahih hangin Jesu in kam khat zong dawng lo hi. Tua ciangin a nungzuite hong pai-in Jesu' tungah thum uh a, “Amah hawlkhia in. I nung hong zui-in kiko niloh hi,” ci uh hi.
Jesu in, “Kei pen Israel innkuan a mangthang tuute' kiang bek ah hong kisawl hi,” ci hi.
Ahi zongin tua numei hong pai-in Jesu' mai-ah khukdin a, “Topa aw, kei hong huh in,” ci hi.
Jesu in, “Naupangte' anlum laksakin uite paih ding kilawm lo hi,” ci hi.
Ahih hangin numei in, “Himah hi, Topa aw. Ahi zongin uite nangawn in a tote' sabuai pana a tote' khateh kiate nekha buang uh hi,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu in, “Numei aw, na upna lian taktak hi! Na lunggulh bangin nang' ading piang ta hen,” ci hi. Tua hunlenai lianin a tanu dam pah hi.
Tua lai pan Jesu paisuakin Galilee Tuili gei tung hi. Tua ciangin mualtung ah kahto-in tua lai-ah tu hi.
Mihon tampite ama' kiangah hong pai uh a, khelbai, khuamulo, khezaw, pautheilo, cihte-a kipan cina dang tampi hong paipih uhin Jesu' khe-phung ah nga uh hi. Jesu in tua mite damsak hi.
Pautheilo mite pau-in, khezaw mite damin, khelbaite lampai-in khuamulo mite in khua mu cih mihonpi in a muh uh ciangin lamdang sa mahmah uh a, Israel mite' Pasian phat uh hi.

Tua ciangin Jesu in a nungzuite a kiangah sam a, “Tu-in mihonte kei tawh ni thum sung hong om khin uh a, nek ding bangmah nei nawnlo uh ahih manin hehpihhuai ka sa hi. Lamkal ah phukhong veikha ding uh ahih manin gilkialsa-in ka ciahsak nuam kei hi,” ci hi.
Nungzuite in, “Hih bang gamlak simtham mun ah mihon hizah vak nading anlum a kicing koi ah va la ding ka hi uh hiam?” ci uh hi.
Jesu in amaute' kiangah, “Anlum pum bangzah nei na hi uh hiam?” a cih ciangin amaute in, “Pum sagih, ngasa neu tawmkhat tawh,” ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu in mihonpi leilak ah tu dingin thupia hi.
Anlum pum sagih leh ngasate la a, hehpihna a phat khit ciangin balnenin nungzuite pia hi. Nungzuite in zong mihonpi piasawn uh hi.
Tua ciangin a vekun gilvah dongin ne uh hi. Khamval anneng teng khawm uh a, sengzing sagih dim ngah uh hi.
An a ne pen numei leh naupang kisim lo, pasal cingteng tulli pha hi.
Mihonpi a ciahsak khit ciangin Jesu gunkuang sungah lutin Magadan kual ah pai hi.
